catalog_quote: 2.1.2. Словесное ударение в У.я. динамическое, падает, за исключением поздних русских заимствований, сохраняющих ударение оригинала, и некоторых глагольных, местоименных и наречных форм, на последний слог слова.

audit.action: cite a better source for the same coding
audit.reasoning: Coding 'fixed-strict, final syllable' (rule 01 001 0001...) is exactly what both held sources say: Kel'makov 1993:241 ('падает... на последний слог слова') and Borise & Georgieva 2024:318,320 (final stress in all word classes, shifting to the rightmost inflectional suffix), with the 2024 acoustic results (§6, p.352) showing duration, intensity, f0 and F1 all cue the stressed final syllable. Both quotations were verified verbatim at the stated pages in the held text files. The record's 'grade' field is blank even though it rests on a specialist sketch plus a current JIPA instrumental study, so the only action is to record an evidence grade (top tier).
